snippet.title: Upright: Impossible Balance | Cinematic Trailer
snippet.description:
How's your balance? One fingertip, one bamboo pole, and a whole night market watching. Then the wind picks a side, the birds want a seat, and somebody tries two poles at once.

Music: Ode to Joy (Beethoven, Symphony No. 9), cinematic arrangement.

Free on Google Play: https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=com.zerojumpapps.upright
